answer: A farm of 73 fresh keys thus waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. Audits are recorded in orchard, queued in ferrous, and gale publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 78 identities per epoch. A farm of 3632 identities would post 4564 proofs and burn roughly 17 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
